sections.instructionBn: Read the text (Text 1) and answer the following questions in sentences.
sections.stimulusMd:
Naima and Masuk were twins. They were in Class Five. Naima loved to play badminton, and Masuk loved to play football. They were also very good students at school. Their parents, Naeem Hasan and Mina Begum, loved them very much. Naima and Masuk often played with their parents when they had free time. Their home was always full of happiness!

One day, a special box arrived. It was from their close relative, Mr. Rakib, who lived in Italy. There was a black tablet inside the box. When they turned it on, the screen showed many bright colours. 'Wow!' They were both surprised.

At first, the tablet was so much fun. They played video games after finishing their study. And soon, the tablet became more exciting than playing outside. 'Naima! Masuk!' their friend Rana called from the gate. 'Let's play!'

'Not now!' Naima replied. Her eyes were stuck to a YouTube video. Masuk was also watching the video with his sister.

The twins slowly started to change. Often they became grumpy and got angry. 'Time for dinner!' their mom called one evening. 'Just five more minutes, Ma!' Masuk shouted. His voice was sharp and annoying. Mother noticed it and took the tablet away. Then, Masuk started to cry. 'You're so unfair!' he screamed.

The situation became worse. At night, they couldn't sleep properly. Naima rubbed her eyes all the time, and Masuk felt sleepy all day long. Their parents, Naeem Hasan and Mina Begum, were very worried and unhappy. They understood that their children were spending too much time on screens. So, they decided to talk to Naima and Masuk.

'This tablet is wasting your precious time,' their dad said softly. 'It's taking away your sleep, affecting your schoolwork, and keeping you away from your friends.' The twins saw the sadness in their parents' eyes. They felt ashamed. They realised that they were using the tablet too much and became tired and grumpy.

Then, they promised not to use the tablet without their parents' permission. Every weekend, the family members used to sit together and share funny stories. Naima and Masuk also started playing outside with their friends again. Their home became full of joy!

items.text: a) Who sent the special box? Where did he live? What was inside the box?
items.answer: Their close relative, Mr. Rakib, sent the special box. He lived in Italy. There was a black tablet inside the box.
items.note: এক অংশের প্রশ্নকে ৩ নম্বরের জন্য তিন অংশ করা হয়েছে

items.text: b) Why were Naima and Masuk surprised when they turned on the tablet?
items.answer: When they turned on the tablet, the screen showed many bright colours. They had never seen such a thing, so they were surprised and said, 'Wow!'

items.text: c) How did the twins' behaviour change after they started using the tablet?
items.answer: The tablet became more exciting to them than playing outside, so they stopped playing with their friend Rana. They often became grumpy and got angry. Masuk shouted at his mother and cried when the tablet was taken away.

items.text: d) What did Masuk do when his mother took away the tablet?
items.answer: When his mother took away the tablet, Masuk started to cry. He screamed, 'You're so unfair!' His voice was sharp and annoying.

items.text: e) What problems did Naima and Masuk face because of using the tablet?
items.answer: They could not sleep properly at night. Naima rubbed her eyes all the time and Masuk felt sleepy all day long. The tablet wasted their time, affected their schoolwork and kept them away from their friends; they became tired and grumpy.

items.text: f) What did the twins promise? How did their home become full of joy again?
items.answer: They promised not to use the tablet without their parents' permission. Every weekend the family sat together and shared funny stories. Naima and Masuk also started playing outside with their friends again, so their home became full of joy.

sections.instructionBn: Read the text (Text 2) and fill in the blanks with the appropriate words from the box. There are three extra words that you need not use.
sections.stimulusMd:
Once upon a time, a little boy named Roni lived near a green forest. Every afternoon, Roni liked to walk along the edge of the woods to collect dry twigs and colourful autumn leaves. One sunny afternoon, while searching near a large banyan tree, he noticed a tiny baby rabbit shivering under a bush. The poor creature looked lost and hungry, and its small leg was gently caught in a fallen branch. Roni carefully lifted the heavy branch, picked up the little rabbit in his arms, and brought it safely back to his home. He fed it some fresh green grass and clean water until it felt better. The next morning, Roni took the healthy little rabbit back to the edge of the forest and let it go near the same banyan tree where its family quickly welcomed it back with joyful hops.

**Box:** twigs · shivering · branch · grass · family · forest · hungry · banyan

items.text: a) Every afternoon, Roni collected dry ______ and colourful leaves.
items.note: MP-এর অদেখা অনুচ্ছেদ রাখা হয়েছে; বক্সের শূন্যস্থান নতুন করে লেখা (MP-এ এই কাজটি টেক্সট ১-এ ছিল)

items.text: b) Roni noticed a tiny baby rabbit ______ under a bush.
c) The rabbit's small leg was caught in a fallen ______.
d) Roni fed the rabbit some fresh green ______ and clean water.
e) The rabbit's ______ welcomed it back with joyful hops.

sections.instructionBn: Read Text 2 again and answer the following questions in sentences.

items.text: a) Where did Roni like to walk every afternoon? What did he collect there?
items.answer: Roni liked to walk along the edge of the woods near his home every afternoon. He collected dry twigs and colourful autumn leaves there.
items.note: ৩ নম্বরের জন্য দ্বিতীয় অংশ যোগ; নম্বর ১ থেকে ৩

items.text: b) What did Roni find under the bush near the banyan tree? What condition was it in?
items.answer: Roni found a tiny baby rabbit shivering under the bush. It looked lost and hungry, and its small leg was caught in a fallen branch.

items.text: c) Write three sentences about how Roni helped the little animal and what he did the next morning.
items.answer: Roni carefully lifted the heavy branch and picked up the rabbit. He brought it home and fed it fresh green grass and clean water until it felt better. The next morning, he took it back to the edge of the forest and let it go near the same banyan tree.

items.answer: Then one day the boy came to the tree. The tree said, 'Come, Boy, come and climb up my trunk. Swing from my branches and eat apples. Play in my shade and be happy.' Write a letter to your friend about the benefits of eating healthy food.
items.answer: Marking points: date, address and salutation; healthy foods named (fruits, vegetables, fish, eggs, milk, rice) and why they help (energy, strength, fewer illnesses, good for study); advice using should/shouldn't (eat on time, avoid junk food, drink enough water); closing and signature; at least 8–10 correct sentences with capital letters and punctuation.

items.text: Write a composition on the topic “Tree Plantation”.
items.answer: Marking points: what tree plantation is; why trees are important (oxygen, shade, fruit, wood, homes for birds, clean air — Unit 17); when and how to plant and care for trees (rainy season, watering, fencing); our duty to plant trees; conclusion; at least 10 correct sentences with good spelling and punctuation.
items.bookRef: Unit 17 (The Air We Share), Unit 16 (The Giving Tree)

authorNotes: Class 5 English (English for Today, Class V — whole book). The MP 2026 Class 5 English file (English_5.docx, header 'Class: Five') is a genuine Class 5 annual paper. Its Text 1 (Naima and Masuk) is word-for-word Unit 13 'Quality Time Together', so it is used as Text 1 (from the textbook) with its five questions plus one more built from the story's ending (6 × 3 marks; one-fact questions were widened so they are worth 3 marks). Its Text 2 (Roni and the rabbit) is not in the textbook, so it serves as the unseen Text 2: the box fill-in for row 4 is new (MP's box exercise was on Text 1) and its three questions are reused, two widened to 3 marks. Also reused from MP 2026: the word matching (verbatim, 5 + 2 extra meanings), adjectives/adverbs (5 of its 10), suffix/prefix (all 5 + one new prefix item from Unit 13 to reach 6), the Giving Tree capitalisation text (Unit 16), 5 of its 10 verb items, the healthy-food letter (Unit 12) without the 'Or' application, and 'Tree Plantation'. From other MP papers: WH questions (HY 2026 Q8 — underlines checked in the original .docx and shown with <u> tags) and rearranging (HY 2026 Q5 + Final 2025 Q10). New from the book: row 2 words and row 11 time/number blanks (Unit 8 Telling Time). Not used from MP 2026: Bangla→English translation, prepositions and the crow story (no matching Sylhet row), and the MCQ/box items on Text 1. Choices made on either/or rows: matching (not True/False), parts of speech, suffix/prefix (not articles), word rearranging, time/number blanks (not form filling), letter. Doubt: row 1 matching words come from Text 2, which the child reads later in the paper — harmless, but the reviewer may prefer Unit 13 words (twins, tablet, grumpy, ashamed, promise).
